# Optimizely

> Optimizely is a digital experience platform. Optimizely One unifies content management, content marketing, digital asset management, commerce, campaign automation, experimentation, feature management, personalization, customer data, and analytics in a single suite, with an AI layer — Opal — that runs agents and virtual teammates across those workflows. Optimizely serves 10,000+ brands.

This file indexes the public marketing site at https://www.optimizely.com, plus the documentation, learning, support, and community properties on other Optimizely subdomains.

How the site is organized:

- Product pages sit directly under /products/ and have no child pages. The site is deliberately flat.
- Every resource type — articles, customer stories, reports, videos, events, Opticon — lives under '/field-notes/'. Older paths such as '/blog', '/resources', '/insights', and '/customers' redirect there.
- Product documentation, API references, and SDKs are **not** on this site; they are on 'docs.developers.optimizely.com'. A full machine-readable dump of that documentation is published at https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/llms-full.txt.
- The site is English at the root. German ('/de') is the only other localized version; legacy locale paths redirect to English.
- Use current product names: Optimizely CMS (not "Content Cloud" or "Episerver"), Optimizely Graph, Optimizely Data Platform (ODP), Optimizely Opal.

## Start here

- [Optimizely](https://www.optimizely.com/): Homepage — what the platform does for marketing and digital teams.
- [All products](https://www.optimizely.com/products): Index of every product in Optimizely One.
- [Plans and pricing](https://www.optimizely.com/plans): How Optimizely is packaged and priced.
- [Get started](https://www.optimizely.com/get-started): Request access, trials, and demos.
- [Product roadmap](https://www.optimizely.com/product-updates): What is shipping next, and why.
- [Contact](https://www.optimizely.com/contact): Sales and general enquiries.

## Products

- [Optimizely Opal — agent platform](https://www.optimizely.com/products/ai): AI agents and virtual teammates embedded in marketing workflows.
- [Opal AI agents](https://www.optimizely.com/agents): Build, orchestrate, and scale agents for specific use cases.
- [Content Management System (CMS)](https://www.optimizely.com/products/content-management): Create, edit, and publish content; headless and visual authoring.
- [Content Marketing Platform (CMP)](https://www.optimizely.com/products/content-marketing): Campaign planning, briefs, collaboration, and content production.
- [Digital Asset Management (DAM)](https://www.optimizely.com/products/asset-management): Store, organize, review, and govern brand assets.
- [Experimentation](https://www.optimizely.com/products/experimentation): A/B and multivariate testing across web and product surfaces.
- [Feature Management](https://www.optimizely.com/products/feature-management): Feature flags, progressive rollouts, and server-side experiments.
- [Personalization](https://www.optimizely.com/products/personalization): Targeted messaging, offers, and content recommendations.
- [Data Platform (ODP)](https://www.optimizely.com/products/data-platform): Customer data platform unifying profiles and events across channels.
- [Analytics](https://www.optimizely.com/products/analytics): Warehouse-connected analytics and Stats Engine reporting.
- [Commerce](https://www.optimizely.com/products/commerce): B2B and B2C digital commerce, preconfigured or fully customizable.
- [Campaign](https://www.optimizely.com/products/campaign): Agentic omnichannel marketing automation and email.
- [Services](https://www.optimizely.com/products/services): Strategy, implementation, and optimization services.
- [Integrations and connectors](https://www.optimizely.com/connectors): Directory of apps and integrations that extend the platform.
- [Beta program](https://www.optimizely.com/beta): Early access to features before general availability.

## Developers

- [Developer hub](https://www.optimizely.com/developers): Entry point for code, SDKs, and guided learning paths.
- [Opal for developers](https://www.optimizely.com/developers/Opal): Extending Opal with custom tools and agents.
- [CMS for developers](https://www.optimizely.com/developers/cms)
- [Commerce for developers](https://www.optimizely.com/developers/commerce)
- [Experimentation for developers](https://www.optimizely.com/developers/experimentation)
- [Optimizely One for developers](https://www.optimizely.com/developers/optimizely-one): How the products fit together architecturally.
- [Front-end developers](https://www.optimizely.com/developers/front-end-developer)
- [Back-end developers](https://www.optimizely.com/developers/back-end-developer)
- [Software developers](https://www.optimizely.com/developers/software-developer)
- [Data engineers](https://www.optimizely.com/developers/data-engineer)

## Documentation and APIs

- [Developer documentation](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/): Home for all product docs, API references, and SDKs.
- [Full documentation as plain text](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/llms-full.txt): Machine-readable dump of the entire documentation site.
- [CMS (SaaS and PaaS)](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/content-management-system/docs/getting-started)
- [Optimizely Graph](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/platform-optimizely/docs/overview-of-optimizely-graph): GraphQL content and commerce query layer.
- [Feature Experimentation](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/feature-experimentation/docs/introduction): Server-side SDKs, flags, and rollouts.
- [Web Experimentation](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/web-experimentation/docs/getting-started): Client-side snippet, APIs, and extensions.
- [Experimentation data](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/experimentation-data/docs/introduction): Event ingestion and enriched results export.
- [Performance Edge](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/performance-edge/docs/overview): Lightweight edge-delivered experimentation.
- [Data Platform (ODP)](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/optimizely-data-platform/docs/welcome): Profiles, events, audiences, and REST APIs.
- [Content Marketing Platform](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/content-marketing-platform/docs/open-api-introduction): CMP and DAM public APIs.
- [Configured Commerce (B2B)](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/configured-commerce/docs/read-first-getting-started-with-b2b-commerce-cloud)
- [Commerce Connect](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/commerce-connect/docs/system-overview)
- [Campaign](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/optimizely-campaign/docs/setting-up-a-domain)
- [Recommendations](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/recommendations/docs/content-recommendations)
- [Connect Platform (OCP)](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/optimizely-connect-platform/docs/developer-platform-overview-ocp2): Build and publish apps, integrations, and Opal tools.
- [Digital Experience Platform (DXP) cloud service](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/digital-experience-platform/docs/getting-started-with-dxp): Hosting, environments, and deployment.

## Learn

- [Field Notes](https://www.optimizely.com/field-notes): All articles, stories, reports, videos, and events in one place.
- [Articles](https://www.optimizely.com/field-notes/articles): Blog on marketing, experimentation, content, and AI.
- [Customer stories](https://www.optimizely.com/field-notes/customer-stories): Results customers achieved, by brand and industry.
- [Reports and guides](https://www.optimizely.com/field-notes/guides): Research, benchmarks, and expert analysis.
- [Videos](https://www.optimizely.com/field-notes/videos): Demos, webinar recordings, and product walkthroughs.
- [Events and webinars](https://www.optimizely.com/field-notes/events): Upcoming sessions, in person and online.
- [Opticon](https://www.optimizely.com/field-notes/opticon): Optimizely's annual conference.
- [Optimizely Academy](https://academy.optimizely.com/student/catalog): Free courses and certifications.

## Partners

- [Find a partner](https://www.optimizely.com/partners): Directory of implementation and solution partners.
- [Become a technology partner](https://www.optimizely.com/partners/become-a-partner/tech): Build and list an integration.

## Company

- [About Optimizely](https://www.optimizely.com/company)
- [Press and announcements](https://www.optimizely.com/company/press)
- [Careers](https://careers.optimizely.com/): Open roles.

## Trust, security, and legal

- [Trust Center](https://www.optimizely.com/trust-center): Security, privacy, and compliance documentation in one place.
- [Security](https://www.optimizely.com/trust-center/security): Technical and organizational safeguards.
- [Privacy](https://www.optimizely.com/trust-center/privacy): How Optimizely handles personal data, including GDPR support.
- [Compliance](https://www.optimizely.com/trust-center/compliance): ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, and related certifications.
- [EU data privacy](https://www.optimizely.com/trust-center/Optimizely-EU-Data-Privacy): EU data residency and transfer commitments.
- [Privacy notice](https://www.optimizely.com/legal/privacy-notice)
- [Website terms of use](https://www.optimizely.com/legal/website-terms-of-use)
- [Sub-processors](https://www.optimizely.com/legal/sub-processors)

## Support and community

- [Support center](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us): Knowledge base and ticketing for customers.
- [Service status](https://status.optimizely.com/): Live and historical uptime for every product.
- [Developer community](https://world.optimizely.com/): Forums, blogs, and NuGet packages, largely CMS and Commerce.
- [Product feedback](https://feedback.optimizely.com/): Submit and vote on feature requests.
- [Log in](https://app.optimizely.com/): Customer sign-in.

## Optional

- [Optimizely auf Deutsch](https://www.optimizely.com/de): German-language version of the site.
- [Marketing and optimization glossary](https://www.optimizely.com/optimization-glossary): Definitions of experimentation, personalization, and marketing terms.
- [Site search](https://www.optimizely.com/search): Filtered search across all optimizely.com content.
- [Optimizers](https://www.optimizely.com/company/optimizers): Content from the people who build and use the platform.
- [Life at Optimizely](https://www.optimizely.com/company/life-at-optimizely): Culture and working here.
- [ESG](https://www.optimizely.com/company/esg): Environmental, social, and governance commitments.
- [Corporate social responsibility](https://www.optimizely.com/company/csr): CSR policy.
